purpose: Retest the union of tasks that previously used model-level GUI, failed the original evaluator, or ended in environment failure. Confirmed dataset defects remain excluded by the 208-task clean source config.

reasons.instruction_requires_external_web_search: instruction explicitly requires external web search
reasons.instruction_implies_live_external_servic: instruction requires a live software store, site, package source, paper lookup, or other external service

filter.setup_downloads_note: OSWorld setup artifact downloads may still use host network; this filter only removes guest external-web workflows and disables the guest proxy.

selection.rule: select a clean-source task when any terminal run2/run3 record has a path_class containing gui, status failed, or status environment_failure

dataset_defect_exclusions.rule: exclude only the task IDs in the evidence-backed dataset defect manifest; do not delete or rewrite historical traces, evaluator output, or source configs
